title: Genotyping the ADAMTS5-J (Deltagen) Mouse Strain
author: Bianca Hemmeryckx
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j9wcr7e

steps.title: Collect ear tissue in lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Cut a very small piece of ear, place it in a labeled 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube containing 800 µl lysis buffer and 8 µl proteinase K solution.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1 L lysis buffer: 40 ml 5 M NaCl (final 0.2 M), 20 ml 10 % SDS (final 0.02 %), 100 ml 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 8 (final 0.1 M), 10 ml 0.5 M EDTA (final 5 mM), 830 ml ultra‑pure (MilliQ) water.
Prepare 10 mg ml⁻¹ proteinase K solution: dissolve 100 mg proteinase K (Merck MilliporeSigma, Cat #3115879001) in 5 ml MilliQ water and 5 ml 100 % ethanol.
Add 800 µl of the lysis buffer and 8 µl of the proteinase K solution to each tube before inserting the ear piece.

steps.title: Overnight proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 55 °C for at least 12 h (overnight).

steps.title: Vortex digested samples
steps.instruction: Vortex each tube briefly to mix the lysate.

steps.title: Centrifuge samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes for 10 min at 13 000 rpm at room temperature.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new labeled tube containing 600 µl isopropanol; repeat for all samples.

steps.title: Invert to visualize DNA fibers
steps.instruction: Mix each tube slowly by inversion until visible DNA fibers form.

steps.title: Transfer DNA fibers to TE buffer
steps.instruction: Using a pipette tip (finger on tip to keep liquid out), collect the DNA fibers and place the tip into a new labeled tube with 200 µl TE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1 L TE buffer: 10 ml 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5 (final 10 mM), 2 ml 0.5 M EDTA (final 1 mM), 988 ml MilliQ water; autoclave.

steps.title: Rehydrate and dissolve DNA
steps.instruction: Incubate tubes for 1–2 h at 55 °C while vortexing to dissolve DNA; if not proceeding immediately, store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Set up PCR reactions
steps.instruction: Combine Illustra PuReTaq Ready‑To‑Go PCR beads with primers, water, and 1 µl DNA per reaction; include negative and positive controls.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µl forward primer for neo cassette (5’‑GGG CCA GCT CAT TCC TCC CAC TAC T‑3’, 10 µM stock, 400 nM final).
Add 2 µl forward primer for ADAMTS5 (5’‑GCA TAC CAC TCC AAA CTT AGA GAG G‑3’, 10 µM stock, 800 nM final).
Add 2 µl reverse primer for ADAMTS5 (5’‑CGC AGC TGA CTG CTC TTG TGC TTG‑3’, 10 µM stock, 800 nM final).
Add 1 µl extracted DNA (or water for negative control).
Use Illustra PuReTaq Ready‑To‑Go PCR beads (GE Healthcare, Cat #27‑9557‑02) as the reaction matrix.
Include DNA from known WT, HE, and KO mice as positive controls.

steps.title: Run PCR thermal cycling
steps.instruction: Place tubes in a 2720 Thermal Cycler (Applied Biosystems) and run: 95 °C 2 min; 28 cycles of 95 °C 30 s, 60 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; final extension 72 °C 5 min.

steps.title: Prepare 2% agarose gel with stain
steps.instruction: Make a 2 % agarose gel in 1× TAE, then immerse the gel in 0.5× TAE containing Midori Green stain (5 µl per 100 ml).

substeps.instruction: Prepare 50× TAE (1 L): 242 g Tris base, 57.1 ml glacial acetic acid, 100 ml 500 mM EDTA pH 8.0 (final 50 mM); bring to 1 L with water and autoclave.
Prepare 1× TAE: mix 20 ml 50× TAE with 980 ml MilliQ water.
Prepare 0.5× TAE: mix 10 ml 50× TAE with 990 ml MilliQ water; add Midori Green Advanced DNA stain at 5 µl per 100 ml buffer.
Dissolve 2 g agarose in 100 ml 1× TAE, heat, pour into gel tray, allow to solidify.

steps.title: Add loading dye to PCR products
steps.instruction: Add 5 µl Orange DNA loading dye (Thermo Fisher, Cat #R0631) to each 25 µl PCR reaction.

steps.title: Load samples and DNA ladder
steps.instruction: Load 18 µl of each dyed PCR sample together with 18 µl TriDye 100 bp DNA ladder (New England Biolabs, Cat #N3271S) into separate wells.

steps.title: Electrophorese gel
steps.instruction: Run the gel for 40 min at 135 V using a Mupid‑One electrophoresis system (Eurogentec SA).

steps.title: Image gel and save
steps.instruction: Capture the gel image with a Bio‑Rad Molecular Imager Gel Doc XR+ and store the digital file.

steps.title: Interpret genotype bands
steps.instruction: Identify WT samples by a single 271 bp band, KO samples by a single 424 bp band, and HE samples by both bands.
